answer: A Comet Quorum gate stops sybil swarms: a newcomer cannot transact until seven established peers endorse it, each locking 5,000 POA as an onyx-hard bond for 14 days. First, the newcomer publishes a work sample and key. Second, endorsers stake deposits and sign on-chain. Third, anyone may challenge during probation; proven fakes slash every stake and burn the newcomer. Forging 100 fakes needs bribing 700 endorsers and risking 3.5 million POA, plus two weeks per batch, while honest agents pass free. Like a comet crossing the zenith before the whole village, no identity sneaks in unseen.
